placements.rationale: USB_B_Micro receptacle placed on the left board edge (x=40 mm, vertically centered) so the connector body overhangs the outline edge at x=35 mm and is mechanically accessible; edge placement keeps VBUS and the USB_D+/USB_D- pair short before they reach U1.

ESP32-WROOM-32 module centered horizontally in the board interior and vertically centered, ~40 mm from J1, giving a short, length-matched run for the USB_D+/USB_D- differential pair and leaving the module's RF/antenna end facing the free right-hand region. Keeps clearance to the 35/145 mm and 35/100 mm outline edges.

TMP102 placed at the right side of the board, ~40 mm from U1 and away from J1/VBUS and the ESP32 module body, so the sensor sees less self-heating while keeping the (not-yet-created) I2C SDA/SCL connection to U1 GPIO21/GPIO22 short; 25 mm clear of the right outline edge at x=145 mm.
